before.content:
running: boolean
  activeRunId: string
  activeRunRevision: number
  snapshotRevision: number
  lastEventSeq: number
  restore: (snapshot: SessionSnapshot) => void

after.content:
if (event.type === "session_snapshot" && event.snapshot) {
      if (event.snapshot.sessionId !== state.sessionId) return state
      next.messages = state.messages
      next.sessionRevision = event.snapshot.sessionRevision ?? state.sessionRevision
      next.snapshotRevision = event.snapshot.snapshotRevision ?? state.snapshotRevision
      next.streamText = ""
      next.tools = {}
